release_name: Resolution Preferences for One, Selected or All Shows
highlights: Download resolution control in Shows and Show Queue for selected shows, saved groups, the whole library or new shows
Reviewed atomic bulk changes, persistent selection across pages and optional new-show default
Single-show resolution in Edit Show Settings; existing files and episode statuses preserved
Resolution enforced in episode/season-pack search and rechecked before downloader handoff; upgrade targets follow preference

validation.clean_install_routes: Isolated real Flask setup covers bulk review/apply, CSRF, malformed/tampered review, stale preferences, single-show editing and preserved existing restore/calendar/provider routes
validation.browser: Isolated 105-show library: selected save, saved group, all shows beyond first page, new-show default, cross-page queue selection and single-show override; no browser console errors
validation.live_downloads: Not performed; controlled fixtures verify mismatch rejection before individual/season-pack handoff
validation.windows_executable: No v18.9.0 executable or Inno installer build claimed

activation: Restart TV Manager normally and refresh open pages. Production process was not restarted.
